items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: But I met him, he came to the house down there.

ctx.x: You were only a year in the post office? That's all I knew. Because you know, I had, Orrin Blackstone had met you, I don't know if you remember him.
Orrin Blackstone was the first one that wrote that article on me. I still have that little book, whether it was Playback or something like that. He was up on Verone Street. Yeah, 439.
That's right. So that's when I just missed you, see I had just come to New Orleans.
